editorial:
Ever had one of those nights where you just cannot shut your brain off? You will totally feel for the main guy in this short clip. He is just trying to get some shut-eye, but everything seems to be working against him. It has that weird, trippy energy you only find in old MTV shows like Liquid Television. The art style is quirky and a bit off-beat, which makes the whole experience feel like a strange dream you cannot wake up from. It is short and sweet, but it captures that feeling of frustration and tiredness perfectly.

What really works here is how the animation mirrors the feeling of being awake when you should be sleeping. The timing is great, and the weird little details keep you interested the whole time. It is not a full movie, so it is a quick watch, but it leaves a mark. If you want to see it, look for it on a streaming site or check out old animation collections. Since it is a short, you don't need a 4K Blu-ray, but watching it in high definition on a big screen makes the odd art pop. It is a great pick for a late-night watch.
endingExplained: As the man continues to struggle with sleep, things get weirder and weirder. The loop of trying to fall asleep becomes a cycle of frustration. In the end, the tension reaches a breaking point where the boundary between being awake and dreaming completely disappears. He never actually gets the peaceful rest he wants, leaving you with the feeling that he is stuck in a loop of insomnia forever.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves odd animation and weird dreams.
